title: Chapter 1408
text:
No matter how shocked the four of them were, Han Xiao's evolution continued to move forward.

The surging golden Mechanical Force formed a huge energy whirlpool, spinning and expanding in circles. It was extremely dazzling, a vast expanse of white. Han Xiao's figure was at the center, drowned in endless light. As for this unlucky planet, it had been completely destroyed. Not a single trace of it was left.

The scorching energy flowed through his body as if it was burning from his cells to his soul. He felt as if he had turned into a piece of steel that was being smelted again and again.

You have met the prerequisite: Activate the Apotheosis Promotion.

[Race Apotheosis] has been activated!

Your life level has reached the peak, and you have opened up a new world above the peak. The domain of a true god is slowly unfolding before your eyes …

Your Exclusive Race [Black Star God Race — Royal Bloodline] has received two new Exclusive Race Talent slots.

Please select your Exclusive Race Talent.

Many options popped up on the interface. Attack, Resistance, Machinery, Attribute Increase, and so on. They were all the effects of the two new Exclusive Race Talents that could be chosen.

When Han Xiao advanced to the Beyond Grade A realm, he had created an Exclusive Race Talent, which was [Mechanical Genius]. At this time, the Race Apotheosis gave him two opportunities to create Exclusive Talents, which were also hereditary talents that could be awakened in his descendants.

He thought about it and chose Ability Strength and Attribute Increase, which were more comprehensive.

Because the new Exclusive Talent he had obtained this time was not like [Mechanical Genius] that had been strengthened many times, the effect would not be too strong. He had expected this.

[Divine Power Gene]: + 10% Ability Strength, + 2% per Promotion

Current Cumulative Bonus: 46%

Current Cumulative Bonus: 3,360 Free Attribute Points

"These two new talents are not bad. Both are abilities with growth potential."

Han Xiao's spirits were lifted.

When he reached the later stages of his growth, he would be able to obtain a one-time accumulation of bonuses. Hence, he would be able to obtain a decent boost from these two new talents.

Although his current attributes were in the tens of thousands, three to four thousand Free Attribute Points was still not a small amount. Most importantly, he could use them as he pleased. Furthermore, Ability Power was an important bonus required by any system, and the degree of increase was quite considerable.

[Mechanical Genius], [Divine Power Gene], and [Natural Elite] were the inherited talents of his race. Individuals with these three Species Talents would undoubtedly have a higher growth potential. They would all be extremely high-quality Super seedlings and would be able to suppress Supers of the same level.

"If only I could create a bunch of smurfs …"

A thought flashed through Han Xiao's mind.

Now that he did not have an inherited race, he felt that the idea of reproducing could be put on the agenda.

While he was thinking, the interface continued to pop up in an orderly manner.

Two new Exclusive Race Talents have been confirmed.

Life Level Sublimation, Molecular Structure Improvement, Organ Structure Enhancement, Metabolism Changes …

[Race Deification] has been completed. Your Grade has been raised to X (Unknown).

Grade S Bonus has disappeared.

You have received Grade X Bonus Attributes.

Grade X Bonus Attributes: + 240 END, + 75% All Resistances, + 50% Highest Attribute, + 30% Other Attributes, + 1,500 Free Attribute Points, and + 60 Awakening Points.

You can choose two of the following seven Talents to form a Grade Talent.

1. Physical Resistance

2. Mental Resistance

3. Additional Power Boost.

4. Health Points

5. Explosive Strength

6. Energy Points

7. Status Enhancement

"There really is a new Grade Talent!" Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

This was an important factor in pulling apart two grades. When he advanced to Beyond Grade A, he could choose two of them, and it was the same now. However, the effect would definitely be stronger, and it could even be stacked with his previous Grade Talents.

The Power Bonus was a must. As for the other one, Han Xiao still preferred his Health Points. Currently, it seemed like he was the only one who had reached this level, so while his tankiness seemed to be enough, most of the increase was actually the basic bonus brought by this Promotion. Normally, completing a Deification Promotion would give such an Endurance bonus, so his current Health Points was probably only at the middle level.

He could not guarantee that no one else would be able to reach this level in the future. Furthermore, there might already be Grade X characters in the universe. At the very least, there would be no mistakes if he continued to develop his advantage of being able to fight and tank.

You have received the Grade Talent [Mighty Divine Power]!

You have received the Grade Talent [Divine Body of the Universe]!

Current Ability Amplification: 312% (This amplification can be stacked with [Superpower] and [Supreme Power])

[Divine Body of the Universe]: Your body is extremely strong and contains unbelievable vitality. Your lifespan will extend until the end of the universe. + 1 END for every level up.

Current Effect: + 360 END (This enhancement can be stacked with [Eternal Body])

"What a powerful enhancement!"

Before Han Xiao could get excited, an even more violent energy erupted from his body, and all of his cells began a new round of transformation. Han Xiao felt that every cell was becoming more and more agitated, as if they were all about to leave his body and escape on their own.

However, as the Ethereal Nation Weapon shook, the struggle of his cells was suppressed, but it also brought him greater pain.

However, although the Species Deification was completed, the Promotion this time was not over. There was still one last wave of transformation left.

Your Class Advancement Mission has been completed.

You have received a new class — [Legendary Mechanic]!

[Legendary Mechanic] Lv.1 + 700 Energy, + 8 STR, + 8 DEX, + 22 END, + 30 INT. You have received 25 Free Attribute Points and 1 Awakening Point.

You have received the talent [Transcendental Artifact]!

You have received the talent [Energy Base-God of All Machines]!

You have received the talent [Information Uniqueness — Conceptual Immortality]!

You have comprehended the skill [Mechanical Deity — Supreme Heavenly Venerate]!

You have comprehended the skill [Virtual Creation (Pseudo)]!

You have comprehended the skill [Life Transformation- Virtual]!

You have comprehended the skill [Life Transformation- Myriad]!

All of your Virtual Technology Skills or Talents have been increased by 80%.

Han Xiao's breathing stopped.

The new class stage was also unfamiliar to him, and [Legendary Mechanic] did not have a Class Level Limit, which meant that this was the last stage of the Mechanic class. He could continue to level up, but there was no Class Advancement after that.

He looked at the new abilities he had obtained during this Class Advancement, and his pupils constricted. The effects of the skills were as fancy as their names, but the bonuses were very shocking.

Han Xiao wanted to analyze his new abilities in detail, but the pain of evolution came wave after wave, causing his mind to almost freeze. Now was not a good time to study it carefully.

Seeing that the notifications on the interface finally stopped, Han Xiao knew that he had obtained all the bonuses from this Promotion. He quickly calmed down and silently felt his evolution. Time quickly blurred.

…

After a full two days, the huge energy vortex that had expanded many times seemed to have expanded to its limit. It slowly shrank toward the center and surged into Han Xiao's body.

At the edge of the area, Wuornos and the other three had been guarding there, watching Han Xiao's Promotion from the beginning to the end. They did not dare to blink at all, afraid that they would miss a second.

As this was the territory of the Black Star Corps, Han Xiao had already informed them that no one was allowed to disturb them. Therefore, even though this place had become the source of cosmic energy and triggered the radar alarms of many organizations, no one came to watch for the past two days.

After a while, the energy vortex retracted into Han Xiao's body. The dazzling light faded, revealing Han Xiao's current appearance.

He floated in the air with his eyes closed, as if he had yet to wake up from his meditation. A special aura rippled around his body, and his skin was emitting a sparkling light. A few ribbons of light golden particles slowly flowed around his body.

Seeing this, Wuornos and the other three hesitated. They were not sure what Han Xiao's current situation was, so they did not immediately approach him.

At this moment, Han Xiao finally opened his eyes. The light on his body faded, and he floated toward the three of them with a smile.

"My Promotion went very smoothly. Thank you, everyone."

Hearing this, the four of them were shocked.

Although they had already guessed it in the past two days, the four of them could not help but feel disbelief when they heard Han Xiao admit it personally.

"You really succeeded? You opened up a higher level of individual strength?! "Milizaus exclaimed.

"That should be the case."

Han Xiao nodded and released a little pressure.

The four of them were stunned. They immediately felt a vast pressure and could not help but feel their hearts palpitate.

However, it only lasted for an instant before Han Xiao retracted the pressure of his life rating, allowing them to heave a sigh of relief.

After the disbelief and shock, they were filled with intense excitement and reverence.

They were all peak Beyond Grade As. Among them, Wuornos and Kasuyi thought that they were half a step away from the threshold of a higher level. Now that they could watch the entire process of Han Xiao's Promotion and see a successful case of breaking through to a higher level, would this method work on them too?

Was this a benefit that Black Star had specially given them?!

"I didn't expect you to succeed in one go … Congratulations."

Wuornos was envious.

He had tried so many times, but in the end, he stopped because he was worried about the risks. However, Black Star had directly rushed forward and entered the soul. Indeed, one's physique could not be compared to another …

However, although Wuornos felt a little jealous, he was more excited and overjoyed. He felt that his judgment was really good. He had not misjudged Black Star. This guy was even more ferocious than he had expected. He had really rushed to a higher level and pointed out the direction for him!

With Black Star leading the way, he could replicate his successful experience today in the future.

The Ethereal National Treasure was his, and the Arcane Church did not lack direct descendants of the five elements. In order to fight against Black Star, the other two Universal Civilizations would more or less provide help … Therefore, among the Beyond Grade As, only he could easily replicate the method that Black Star used today. It was undoubtedly the most profitable!

Although Black Star did not fail, which was out of his expectations, causing his little plan to fail, in his eyes, this trip was not in vain!

Thinking of this, Wuornos felt extremely comfortable and decided to prepare for his Promotion when he returned.

However, at this moment, he suddenly remembered that the Ethereal National Treasure was still in Han Xiao's hands. He did not know how strong Black Star had become. If he had any ill intentions …

Wuornos' heart tightened, and he secretly tensed up. He slowly said, "Black Star, can you return it to me?"

"Oh, take it."

Han Xiao glanced at him. Seeing how nervous he was, he shook his head with a smile, took out the Ethereal National Treasure from his chest, and casually threw it back to Wuornos. He had no intention of taking it for himself.

Since the other party did not cause any trouble and specially came to help him, he would not easily burn bridges. He still had this basic integrity. There was no need to make enemies because of this. At most, he could just borrow it again next time. Furthermore, the Ethereal National Treasure was not the only 'stabilizer'. After completing the Promotion, Han Xiao already had some new ideas.

Wuornos took the Ethereal National Treasure and stuffed it back into his body. He secretly heaved a sigh of relief and was overjoyed.

Kasuyi looked at the Ethereal National Treasure with a burning gaze and looked at Han Xiao again.

"Your Promotion is a good thing for the entire Beyond Grade As. I wonder if you plan to publicize this method?"

"Keep it a secret for now. Don't tell anyone about this for the time being to avoid any trouble. To be honest, this Promotion is quite dangerous. If I fail, I might not be able to use the Sanctum Revival."

Han Xiao waved his hand.

He actually did not care much about this. What the four of them saw was only the surface. Even if they imitated his method, they would not be able to trigger the Promotion because they were missing an important factor, the Beyonder's Vestige.

Now that he had successfully advanced and was no longer in a critical state, he had also lost his sense of the Beyonder's Vestige. As long as he did not specifically remind them, the others might not be able to activate this feeling by themselves. Furthermore, without a detailed interface notification, others might not know what this feeling meant.

Most importantly, the only Beyonder's Vestige left in the explored universe had already been consumed by him. Even if someone knew the use of the Beyonder's Vestige, they would have to go to the unexplored areas to find it. Who knew how long it would take.

Hearing this, other than Wuornos, Kasuyi and the others were shocked and suppressed the impulse in their hearts.

Milizaus suddenly thought of something and asked, "By the way, the new grade hasn't been defined in the galactic society yet. Why don't you give it a name?"

Sierron agreed. "Indeed, the name Beyond Grade A is to commemorate the exploration era. Now that the new level has appeared, we need a new name. It will definitely be recorded in history. You're the founder, so only you have the right to name it."

Han Xiao stroked his chin and did not refuse. He immediately thought of the name of the class and raised his brows.

"How about … the Transcendent Grade?"

"Sounds good."

The few of them naturally did not have any objections to a name and nodded.

"Then it's settled. Above Beyond Grade A is called the Transcendent Grade."

Han Xiao nodded with a smile.

At this moment, Kasuyi could not hold back his curiosity and sized up Han Xiao.

"Black Star, what's the power of the new level? How powerful is it?"

Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he shook his head with a smile.

"It's very, very strong …"

As he spoke, he looked at the interface, and an inexplicable expression flashed across his eyes.

Total Level: 360

Main Class: Mechanic

Race: Black Star God System — Royal Bloodline

Attributes: 33810 STR, 29423 DEX, 44310 END, 81744 INT, 26854 MYS, 12560 CHA, 1 LUK

Free Attribute Points: 5,105

Awakening Points: 101

Health: 122,694,490

Stamina: 98,274,600

Energy: 481200

Energy Rank: 148800 Ona

Grade: X

Grade X Bonus Points: + 240 END, + 75% All Resistances, + 50% Highest Attribute, + 30% Other Attributes, + 1,500 Free Attribute Points, and + 60 Awakening Points.

(You have cleared the fog ahead, and a brand new path extends beneath your feet. From today onwards, the heavens and earth will be born together with you, and all things will be one with you … You are the universe!)
